# AthenaX

> AthenaX is a discovery platform for frontier technology products and research. It is where new products begin — a NounsDAO-incubated platform that surfaces research-backed, early-stage products across frontier technology sectors. Currently in public beta.

AthenaX operates at the intersection of research and product discovery. Every product on the platform is grounded in indexed research, and every founder is ARS-scored. The platform is CC0 — no rights reserved, open source — and is powered by NounsDAO.

Sectors covered: AI & Agents, Robotics, Biotech, Crypto & DeFi, Dev Tools, Infrastructure, Climate & Energy, and Real World Assets (RWA).

AthenaX is currently in Phase 00 (Genesis), its operational launch phase. Upcoming platform phases include Network (Q3 2026), Terminal (Q4 2026), Economy (2027), and Autonomy (2028+).

Community channels: X (@athenax_co), Discord, YouTube (@AthenaX_co), LinkedIn (athenaxco), and Instagram (@athenax_co). Bi-weekly newsletter delivers top research papers, bounties, and cohort news every Monday.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://athenax.co/): Platform overview, network activity stats, and the latest product launches.
- [Launch](https://athenax.co/launch): Directory of early-stage products across AI, robotics, biotech, crypto, developer tools, infrastructure, and climate. Filterable by category and recency, and searchable.
- [Research](https://athenax.co/archive): Knowledge archive of artifacts, learnings, and broadcasts — Articles (whitepapers, livestreams, roundtables) and Broadcast videos.
- [Roadmap](https://athenax.co/roadmap): What AthenaX is building now and next, by phase.

## Content detail pages

- Individual product: `https://athenax.co/launch/{slug}`
- Individual article: `https://athenax.co/archive/{slug}`
- Individual broadcast: `https://athenax.co/archive/broadcast/{slug}`

## Actions

- Submit a product: open the submission flow from [Launch](https://athenax.co/launch?submit).
